name: Yoichi (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Yoichi town emblem in yellow: a five-pointed star bearing a ring with a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Yoichi, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 27 March 1935.

features.role: Yoichi town emblem — a five-pointed star bearing a ring with a stylised character
